title: NB3702: Smart App Control blocks unsigned ExternalConnectors.dll, preventing RDP connections
author: sunstarjeff
body_snippet:
## Description

mRemoteNG **1.78.2 Nightly Build 3702 x64 Self-Contained** launches normally, but Windows 11 Smart App Control has begun blocking `ExternalConnectors.dll`.

When the DLL is blocked, mRemoteNG itself opens normally, but RDP connections do not start.

NB3702 previously worked normally on the same system for approximately two weeks.

## Environment

- **mRemoteNG:** 1.78.2 Nightly Build 3702 x64 Self-Contained
- **Protocol affected:** RDP
